To work properly, Blaze Player will ask for a few permissions, all at once:

• Photos, music and videos: to show your library and Blaze Gallery
• Notifications: for playback controls
• Local network: to discover Blaze Party guests
• Microphone: only for the dynamic visual equalizer — no audio is ever recorded

How to prepare your audio library
When you add local or network folders to your library for the first time, please be patient: loading metadata and artwork can take a long time, especially if you have many albums or tracks.
For Blaze Audio to organize your music correctly, follow the structure below as closely as possible.
Place the cover artwork in the album folder using the name cover.jpg or cover.png.
Place .lrc lyric files next to each track, using exactly the same filename.
You must save the paths to your files on your local network here so that you can browse them later in the app.
